# Krillion Unlimited

> An independent Krillion-inspired daily trivia game. Not affiliated with the original Krillion service.

Canonical: https://krillion-unlimited.app/

## Play
Seven open-answer prompts, a 3-second preview, and 25 seconds per answer. Prepared rarity tiers award 10, 15, 30, 60, 85 or 100 points. Seven answers can total 700 points and 7,000 metres.

Choose Begin Descent, read the category, type an answer, press Enter or Dive, confirm a proposed correction if shown, then continue. After round seven, Surface opens the score report and accepted-answer review.

Daily resets at midnight America/New_York. Practice is separate. Guest settings and history have a device-local copy; random browser identifiers and completed game records are held by this service. Comparisons use this site's players only.

## Limits
No generative model, credits, payment flow, themed packs, user login or official affiliation. The public source ships a small independently assembled sample bank. Official question synchronization is disabled; only the independent bank is used.

These documents are rendered from the same public product configuration used by the website. Changes take effect on deployment. External AI links only prefill a public question and may require a provider account; answers and indexing are not guaranteed.
